verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's own Subscriptions docs cover recurring billing with weekly, monthly or yearly frequency, trial periods, configurable proration and automatic payment retries. The CLI can also operate subscriptions. Plan upgrades or downgrades are never mentioned, and plans as a distinct object are only implied. Missing for 10: documented plan objects, upgrade/downgrade flows, depth on how proration works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Customizable billing frequency: weekly, monthly, or yearly.
Offer a trial period for customers to get to know your service.
Configure proration, if you want to offer it.
Automatic retries if a payment is rejected.
With a single token, you can operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports
